input: Plan a multi-generational holiday for the whole family

gold.taskDescription: Plan a holiday trip that accommodates family members across multiple generations, from children to grandparents.

questions.title: How many people are coming, and what are their ages?
questions.description: Understand the full group size and age range to tailor activities and accommodation.

questions.title: What is your target travel dates or time of year?
questions.description: Pinpoint when the holiday needs to happen to align schedules and availability.

questions.title: What is the overall budget for the entire group?
questions.description: Establish financial boundaries to guide destination and accommodation choices.

questions.title: Do you have a destination in mind, or is it open?
questions.description: Determine whether a location has been shortlisted or needs to be selected from scratch.

questions.title: Are there any mobility or health needs to accommodate?
questions.description: Identify physical limitations among older or younger family members that affect venue and activity choices.

questions.title: Do you prefer one shared property or separate hotel rooms?
questions.description: Clarify accommodation style, such as a villa, holiday home, or hotel block booking.

questions.title: What activities matter most to the different age groups?
questions.description: Capture must-have experiences for kids, adults, and grandparents to ensure everyone is engaged.
